name: Arnót (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Arnót: a shield of red and blue with a helm, a yellow crest and red and blue mantling, above a scroll inscribed ARNÓT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Arnót arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
